limits.scope: imagenet: three existing images x Gaussian61/sigma3 zero boundary and random70% missing; DPS/SHRINK only. Completes missing A75/A77 task cells.
limits.baseline: Original vendored native1000 DDPM learned_range DPS loop and PS condition; official task scales Gaussian=.3, inpainting=.5. Existing A71 physical operators, not author benchmark reproduction.
limits.observation: NEW shared y per pair, model[-1,1] sigma=.05. Full-output additive Gaussian noise retained, including missing coordinates, as in official DPS sample_condition.py. Mask fixed from case seed; measurement is never replaced/clamped.
limits.module: Unchanged A71 continuous noise_signal_shrink.select; observed RGB entries only for inpainting. Same-time Hq/sqrt(alpha) proxy. No beta, clipping2, calibration or next-denoiser probes.
limits.pairing: Independent from seed; same observation/operator, initial/final CPU+CUDA RNG fingerprints and grid required. Alternating two-arm run order; no learned state.
limits.cost: 1000 forwards+1000 existing input VJP per run. Scalar module adds three H evaluations per step (residual plus two response evaluations); no extra NN/VJP/optimizer.
limits.resources: FFHQ>=6GiB, ImageNet>=10GiB free before load; real checkpoint VJP peak+1GiB required before attempts. No precision/resolution change, no process termination.
limits.timing: Full reconstruction includes given-y load/operator/init/native1000/outputCPU sync/bookkeeping; model load, probe, shared observation creation, metrics and artifact writes separately recorded. Same NFE/VJP per arm.
limits.output: Original returned DPS next-state; no clean-output replacement or GT-based output selection. Save original GT/observation/BASE/SHRINK PNGs and fixed triptych per case.
limits.decision: Per dataset/task: mean PSNR>=+.1dB, >=2/3 image wins, SSIM nondecrease, LPIPS nonincrease, paired noise/grid pass. Preserve mixed and negative results without tuning.
limits.limits: Small reused panel, one seed, sigma=.05 only. No universal/state-necessity/posterior guarantee; positive scalar DPS amplitude may be canceled by projection. No rerun of completed SR/Motion.
